# DentalHQ (DentalHQ, LLC)

DentalHQ is a Software Development company. DentalHQ is a dental membership plan platform that offers customizable dental membership plans for insured and uninsured patients, increase patient loyalty, and ensure predictable revenue. DentalHQ employs 10 people, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Zimbabwe. Has $2.6M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Introducing DentalHQ: the revolutionary in-house membership platform for dentists. Our platform empowers dentists to attract and retain fee-for-service patients while eliminating the hassles of dental insurance. With DentalHQ, you can provide uninsured patients with budgetary control over their dental care, reducing the #1 barrier to attracting uninsured patients: cost. 

Our platform, designed by a dentist, promotes overall patient health by removing barriers to oral healthcare and fosters a direct relationship between you and your patients. Our Saas application allows you to create custom dental membership plans, automate billing and reporting, and includes services to attract and retain new members. 

In addition to plan management, our platform offers patient financing tools, integrated marketing services, expert consultation, patient outreach, and new patient acquisition services, all designed to help you see more fee-for-service patients and increase practice revenue substantially. With a customer retention rate of 94.7%, our proven solutions have helped thousands of practitioners, DSOs, and dental professionals. Choose DentalHQ for the best value in in-house membership plan management.

# DentalHQ Joins the Inc 5000 List of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies, Marking Their First Time on the List

## August 12, 2025

Raleigh, NC, August 12, 2025 -Inc., the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future, today announced that DentalHQ is one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, landing on their annual Inc. 5000 list. The list provides a data-driven snapshot of the most successful companies within the economy’s most dynamic segment—its independent, entrepreneurial businesses. Past honorees include Microsoft, Meta, Chobani, Under Armour, Timberland, Oracle, and Patagonia.

“This accomplishment is testament to a vision brought to life by our founder, Dr. Brett Wells, and the dedication, hard work, and unwavering commitment of our incredible team,” said Kendra Hunter, COO of DentalHQ.Founded in 2017, DentalHQ provides industry-leading membership plan software designed to help dental practices reduce insurance dependency, retain more patients, and create predictable recurring revenue. The platform offers plans for every patient, seamless PMS integration, guaranteed plan payments, and marketing tools like BusinessCONNECT and CommunityCONNECT—making it the most responsive, intuitive, and connected membership solution on the market.Today, DentalHQ serves practices nationwide, from solo offices to DSOs and multi-location groups, helping them increase patient loyalty, boost treatment acceptance, and automate administrative tasks so teams can focus on care, not paperwork. See DentalHQ in action today!“Making the Inc. 5000 is always a remarkable achievement, but earning a spot this year speaks volumes about a company’s tenacity and clarity of vision,” says Mike Hofman, editor-in-chief of Inc. “These businesses didn’t just weather the storm—they grew through it, and their stories are a powerful reminder that the entrepreneurial spirit is the engine of the U.S. economy.”

For the full list, company profiles, and a searchable database by industry and location, visit: www.inc.com/inc5000.Inc. will celebrate the honorees at the 2025 Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala, taking place October 22-24 in Phoenix, and the top 500 will be listed in the fall issue of Inc. magazine.About DentalHQ

DentalHQ is a leading membership plan management platform built for dental practices to help them attract, retain, and grow their patient base without the limitations of traditional insurance. Through features like plans for every patient, seamless PMS integration, guaranteed plan payments, team incentives, and marketing tools like BusinessCONNECT and CommunityCONNECT, DentalHQ makes membership plans easy for teams and valuable for patients. Serving solo practices, DSOs, and multi-location groups, DentalHQ helps practices create predictable revenue, strengthen patient relationships, and simplify operations through automation. For more information, visit www.dentalhq.com.

Methodology

Companies on the 2025 Inc. 5000 are ranked according to percentage revenue growth from 2021 to 2024. To qualify, companies must have been founded and generating revenue by March 31, 2021. They must be U.S.-based, privately held, for-profit, and independent—not subsidiaries or divisions of other companies—as of December 31, 2024. (Since then, some on the list may have gone public or been acquired.) The minimum revenue required for 2021 is $100,000; the minimum for 2024 is $2 million. As always, Inc. reserves the right to decline applicants for subjective reasons.

About Inc.

Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures LLC, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.

# Open Wide: Raleigh-based DentalHQ Raises $1.5 Million Seed Round

 February 14, 2022 Suzanne Blake Funding 

Raleigh-based DentalHQ provides a SaaS solution to dental practices to create and operate membership programs for their patients.

Raleigh-based DentalHQ has secured $1.5 million in equity funding, the company announced last week. With this money, the startup intends to invest in product development and marketing as well as hire a day-to-day head of operations to propel the dental membership software company to the next level, said DentalHQ Founder Dr. Brett Wells.

“We’ve got all these awesome products that we’ve had on the back burner that we just couldn’t build because we didn’t have the capital to build out our development team that we can now,” Wells said.

The investment came from a group of individual angel investors, including Doug Brown, the former CEO of Raleigh-HQ’d Affordable Dentures & Implants, which was acquired by the private equity firm Berkshire Partners in 2015. 

This was a strategic move away from VC funding because of the quality of individual investors interested, Wells said, although he wouldn’t rule out the VC route down the line. Previous to this round, DentalHQ had taken little outside investment.

“We had opportunities to take some VC money—a fairly significant amount of VC money,” Wells said. “But when you’ve got angel investors that are this strategic, heavily involved in the dental space, very successful in their own right, with tons of connections and great input… It didn’t make sense to take VC money.” 

Ryan Vet, who was the founder of Durham-based healthcare staffing platform Boon—which we wrote about in 2019 and was later acquired by CrowdfundNC—has become one of DentalHQ’s advisors. He said Wells’ approach to the business as both a practicing dentist and a savvy entrepreneur sets the company apart from any other in the dental membership plan space.

“The great thing about DHQ is that it is having a positive impact for not only dentists and practice owners, but also for patients,” Vet said.

Vet has no doubt that Wells and his team will use the money and take DentalHQ to the next level.

“The exciting thing is that DHQ was positioned well before the round,” Vet said. “After closing this round, they have an even greater opportunity to make a positive impact in dentistry.”

Wells, who describes himself as a dentist by trade and an entrepreneur by passion, founded DentalHQ based on the problems he was seeing while running several dental practices in Raleigh (which he continues to do).

DentalHQ Founder Dr. Brett Wells

A few years ago, Wells had started offering membership plans with discounts for uninsured patients to be more affordable and transparent. But he realized that the membership programs, while great at retaining existing patients, did not successfully attract many new patients. Wells wanted a solution that would take the large annual costs of the package of membership services and break them down into monthly costs in a way that was easy for both the dental practices and their patients.

Since one didn’t exist, he started building it himself in what would become DentalHQ, launching in 2017. DentalHQ’s SaaS solution allows dental offices to easily set up and implement in-house, completely customizable membership plans.

It’s all part of Wells’ mission to reduce the barriers of cost to dental care. He said only about half of people go to the dentist every year, and only one in five who don’t have insurance will go to the dentist. With easy access to membership plans, dentists can grow their clientele and provide care to those it may have been inaccessible for previously.

Wells said DentalHQ is constantly adding solutions to make dentists’ lives easier. One, BusinessConnect, launched in the last year. It allows small businesses to offer membership plans to their employees, independently choosing how much to subsidize for each plan.

“That’s a tool that we think can really, as it evolves, be the first true competition for dental insurance, which is just a totally broken, antiquated, outdated system,” Wells said.

##### Benefits of bootstrapping

Part of the benefit in Wells not having a traditional technology or business background is that it ensured the tech would be easy to use for other dentists, he said. Currently, DentalHQ serves 30,000 members and around a thousand dentists’ offices.

“I didn’t really have a full understanding of technology and user experience and ease of use,” Wells said. “So the cool thing about bootstrapping our way to this point ahead of the raise was we had to build a technology that was very easy to use because we didn’t have this giant support/success team.”

It was important to educate dentists on the benefits of membership plans and act as a resource on how to run their businesses better first before attempting to sell them anything, according to Wells.

“That was a big learning for us—that in the dentistry space it’s not about just spending money on marketing and sales,” Wells said. “It’s about actually educating and improving the space and helping dentists be better at the business side of dentistry.”

Now with the funding help, DentalHQ is just getting started. Over the next year, Wells said that the startup plans to release a new version of its dashboard that will allow for more analytical tools for dentists, and to build more fintech solutions to serve dentists.

About DentalHQ | Revolutionizing Dental Membership Plans

## Empowering Every Practice, Every Step of the Way

DentalHQ was created by a dentist, for dentists, so that dentists can thrive independently and deliver exceptional care without the hassle of insurance constraints.

## Do you ever feel like running your dental practice is like juggling flaming torches while riding a unicycle?

You're not alone! You're a dental professional, and you've got a thousand things on your plate - patient appointments, insurance headaches, team management, and oh, did we mention paperwork? And everything increases when you have more than one location. It's overwhelming! Do you ever just need a magic wand to make things easier? To have predictable revenue, happy patients, and a practice that runs like a well-oiled machine? 

Or, what about: 

- A Membership Plan that automates itself
- Less dependence on insurance companies
- A solution for single location offices
- A solution for multi-location offices
- A solution for DSOs 
- A way to reach your community and local businesses

## If that sounds like you, you're in the right place!

At DentalHQ, we craft innovative solutions for dental professionals who are ready to simplify practice management, boost revenue, and deliver exceptional care to both insured and uninsured patients. If you're seeking to streamline operations, reduce reliance on insurance, and grow your practice, you've found the right partner. 

DentalHQ is the top choice for dental membership plans, trusted by numerous state dental associations and professional partners. We're a proven solution. Our platform has helped countless practices optimize operations, enhance patient care, and significantly increase profits. It's easy to use and packed with powerful features, which is why dental professionals nationwide rely on us. 

A membership plan is great just because it motivates those patients like you said to accept more of the treatment that they need rather than putting it off until something's broken or hurt.

## How Does DentalHQ Work?

Schedule a FREE demo with us, or watch our demo video to see how DentalHQ can revolutionize your practice. In just a few clicks, you'll enroll and be on your way to creating your own membership plan.

Once your plans are set, DentalHQ automates the rest. From billing to patient management, our platform streamlines everything. As your membership plan grows, your improved workflow goes with it! 

Our experts will help you tailor a membership plan that suits your practice and patient base. You'll create plans that cater to both insured and uninsured patients, ensuring everyone has access to affordable dental care. 

### Implement and enjoy the benefits 

Picture this: A thriving practice with loyal patients who consistently keep their appointments and can't stop praising your care. With a membership plan for your practice, you'll enjoy predictable revenue and a smoother, more efficient practice - the boost your practice needs to reach new heights. 

## The DentalHQ Story

Dr. Brett Wells saw the headache of trying to keep track of a membership plan for his 7 practices. Patients would promise to renew "next time," but it often took 14 -18 months (if they renewed at all). 

His team would have extra work trying to figure out who was on the membership plan, who was up for renewal, and how to bill them. He KNEW there had to be a better way! Enter automation! With a team of former dental office pros, he built a platform that makes life easier for everyone. Automated renewals? Check. Multi-location management? Double check. Streamlined notifications? You bet. We've got it all! We've partnered with state dental associations and top industry experts to create the most endorsed platform around. And the best part? We're always listening to our customers and innovating to improve our platform FOR YOU. 

## With DentalHQ, you're not just getting software - you're getting a team that gets you.

We're helping healthcare happen with our innovative fintech solutions that provide greater access to patient care.

### What kind of support can i expect as a dentalhq customer?

DentalHQ provides live phone, chat and text message support to our customers, and of course 24/7 email support with a crazy-fast response time. And while we happily support all Members on our platform, because of potential regulatory compliance issues we strongly recommend that Members communicate directly with their dental office. This is the relationship most of our partner offices prefer. But that's not enough. Beyond mere "support," we're here to provide success. DentalHQ was founded by a dentist, and is endorsed by dentist, dental societies, dentist buying groups, and dental networks throughout the country. Client Success is extremely important to us - your success is our success is the dental industry's success. 

### Does DentalHQ provide training?

Do we ever!! Customer Success is one of our core values. It is our goal that you absolutely crush it with your dental membership plan. And the BEST way to help you with that is training. We provide complimentary live web training to help you create the best dental membership plan for your practice. We also provide team training to teach your staff how to use the platform, and most importantly, how to talk about your plan with your patients. Need a refresher? We do those too! 

### Is Dentalhq "hipaa compliant?"

Short answer. Yes. Slightly-less short answer: We make every effort to align our operations with HIPAA regulations. Complete answer: Let's discuss. First of all, there is no "official" certification process to be formally recognized as "HIPAA compliant." In fact, the enforcement agency for HIPAA cautions companies and patients on false or misleading advertising related to HIPAA compliance and states that it does not certify any persons or products as "HIPAA compliant." A business that does make this claim is being disingenuous at best. At DentalHQ, we take member confidentiality extremely seriously – after all, we were started by a dentist, and Dr. Wells knows better. To that end, we've made it a priority to implement reasonable and appropriate physical, administrative, and technical safeguards designed to align with applicable regulations relating to Protected Health Information (PHI). If you have any questions about our privacy and data security practices, please contact us at support@dentalhq.com or 833-222-HQ4U (4748). 

### Can my members transfer offices?

Only if that office is part of a multi-location practice. Members cannot move to another practice that is not a part of that multi-location group. Your membership plan is your membership plan, at your office or practice group. When your patient joins your membership plan, whether through your online signup form, your in-office enrollment form, they become your member. Not our member, not anyone else's member. Yours. 

### does dentalhq dictate anything about my membership plan?

No. You decide what your membership plan includes and how it's worded on your signup form and information cards. You decide how much it costs, what it's called, if you offer monthly or annual payments or both. You decide any age restrictions you wish to apply, family discounts, additional treatment discounts, and even whether or not you want to list your office on our website. However, we do offer guidance using our years of dental experience to help implement best practices. It's YOUR membership plan. 

### What merchant fees are charged with dentalhq?

DentalHQ is fully integrated with Stripe for online payment processing. Stripe's processing can be found here. You can accept ACH, credit and debit card payments, as well as the ability to accept cash or check for the purchase of annual plans. 

### How often is the dentalhq platform updated?

All the time! DentalHQ makes minor updates and improvements weekly. Major product upgrades are rolled out every few months! Feel like you need something we don't have? Let us know! 

Contact us at hq@dentalhq.com
